description: This PHP class 'EmployeeReportData' provides data processing for employee time reports within the OrangeHRM Time module. It retrieves timesheet items, formats durations, and supplies report metadata including total durations and employee info.

classes.name: EmployeeReportData
classes.description: Provides data for employee time reports, including retrieving timesheet entries, formatting durations, and fetching report metadata such as total time and employee info.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Retrieves timesheet items for an employee report, formats each item, and returns an array suitable for report output.

methods.name: getMeta
methods.description: Returns metadata for the report, including total duration, count of timesheet items, and normalized employee information.
